notes:
Fix: a cancelled app-bundle install no longer leaves an empty folder behind.
- In 1.6.0, cancelling (or a failed) install of an XAPK with game data removed the copied game data but left an empty Android/obb/<app> folder that BFE had made. BFE now removes that folder again, only when BFE made it and it is empty. Folders and game data that were already there are not touched.

Tried on a Pocket FIT: installing an XAPK with game data and pressing Cancel on Android's screen. The folder is gone afterwards. Not tried yet: a finished install, Convert, folders of split APKs, and the clean-up when BFE needs root to copy game data.
